name: @aipeople/desktop
author: clb <lamthebest@foxmail.com>
description: Easy Control：微博、知乎、抖音、小红书运营与循环视频念稿直播的独立 Windows 应用

scripts.dev: tsx ../../scripts/sync-desktop-runtime.ts && concurrently -n vite,electron -c green,yellow "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env-shell ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run sync-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:portable: npm run sync-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.yml
